treatment: Official launch, price, availability, effort controls, safeguards, and initial benchmark claims are covered. Reinclude only for independent reproducible evaluations, material price or access changes, significant safety findings, or deployment incidents.
known_facts: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on 2026-07-24 across all platforms with API model ID claude-opus-5.
API pricing is $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, unchanged from Opus 4.8; Fast mode is about 2.5 times faster at twice the base price.
Anthropic positions Opus 5 near Fable 5 performance at roughly half the cost per task and as the new default on Claude Max and strongest model on Claude Pro.

Official claims include state-of-the-art results on Frontier-Bench and GDPval-AA, strong cost-adjusted performance on CursorBench, AutomationBench, and OSWorld 2.0, and improved life-sciences performance over Opus 4.8.
Anthropic reports Opus 5 as its most aligned recent model, behind Mythos 5 in biology and offensive cybersecurity, with cyber classifiers expected to intervene about 85% less often than on Fable 5.
The launch adds beta mid-conversation tool changes and automatic safety fallbacks on the API.
reinclude_only_if: Independent benchmarks or real-world agent tests materially confirm or contradict Anthropic's coding, computer-use, knowledge-work, efficiency, or reliability claims.
Anthropic changes pricing, plan access, platform availability, effort settings, Fast mode, API behavior, or safety fallback behavior.
A system-card correction, safety incident, material misuse report, or government action concerns Opus 5.
Cloud providers or major developer platforms materially change Opus 5 availability.
notes: Official launch facts and Anthropic benchmark/safety claims are covered; most performance claims still require independent validation.
